text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_anv: Anvils cost experience points and never say Too Expensive. Off = vanilla level cost
text.summy_enchantment.option.anvil_max_: Cost is capped at this level's experience points, default 30 (1395 points); it never gets more expensive afterwards
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_cus: Uses SharpnessPlus: vanilla Sharpness leaves the random pool and the two are exclusive. Off restores vanilla Sharpness
text.summy_enchantment.option.sharpness_: Bonus attack damage per level of SharpnessPlus. Default 1.5
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_str: Strength becomes multiplicative. Off restores vanilla Strength (+3 per level, additive)
text.summy_enchantment.option.strength_m: Damage multiplier per level of StrengthPlus: 0.5 = +50% per level
text.summy_enchantment.option.apply_stre: Whether mob melee attacks also get the StrengthPlus multiplier
text.summy_enchantment.option.debug_logs: Prints verification-only log lines ([SE-SR] per-hit settlement, Death's Eye clears, HUD self-check, particle style echo); off by default to avoid spam
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_pro: Unlocks vanilla Protection 5 (combine two Protection IV on an anvil)
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_imp: Impaling follows Bedrock rules (works on wet or rained-on targets). Off restores vanilla
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_inf: Allows Infinity and Mending on the same item
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_cro: On: bows accept Multishot/Piercing (and they work), crossbows accept Power/Infinity/Flame/Punch plus this mod's bow enchantments. Off: both directions are disabled
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_loy: Keeps the trident; a phantom trident flies out instead, and you cannot throw again until it returns
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_spe: Hits deal extra magic damage based on a percentage of the damage
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_beh: Kills may drop the matching head (no Ender Dragon)
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_exe: Finish off targets below the health threshold (treasure)
text.summy_enchantment.option.execution_: Health ratio that triggers the execution, 0.15 = 15%
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_aut: Mined drops are smelted when a smelting recipe exists (off while sneaking)
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_qui: Bows reach full draw faster (animation matches)
text.summy_enchantment.option.quick_draw: Seconds removed from full draw per level, 0.10 = 0.1s
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_ins: A fully drawn bow fires automatically and starts the next draw (treasure enchantment)
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_lif: Healing grants absorption (golden hearts) that stacks with golden apples
text.summy_enchantment.option.life_shiel: Healing-to-shield ratio and cap factor per level, 0.20 = 20%
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_hea: +1 max health per level; the four armour pieces stack
text.summy_enchantment.option.health_boo: Max health added per level of Health Boost. Default 1.0
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_lif: Heal for a percentage of the damage you deal
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_sch: Only experience orbs give more XP
text.summy_enchantment.option.scholar_bo: Extra experience orb XP per level, 0.10 = +10%
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_cal: Curse: health cannot exceed 1 (max health and healing are unaffected)
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_dea: You take more damage, but the lower your health, the more you deal and the less you take
text.summy_enchantment.option.deaths_ble: Outgoing damage gained per 1% health lost, 0.01 = +1%
Incoming damage reduced per 1% health lost, 0.005 = -0.5%
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_rev: Raise sword/axe/trident melee damage for a short time after being hit
text.summy_enchantment.option.revenge_bo: Bonus added per level, 0.10 = +10% per level (+25% at level 3)
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_dea: Burst of particles where a player dies
text.summy_enchantment.option.death_part: Particle type for the death burst, default 12 firework
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_qui: Increases the attack speed of the held sword or axe
text.summy_enchantment.option.quick_stri: Attack speed added per level of Quick Strike (additive), 0.10 = +0.1
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_mul: All three Multishot arrows affect the same target
text.summy_enchantment.option.multishot_: Spread angle of Multishot; vanilla is 10
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_pot: Instant damage arrows no longer have their potion damage eaten by the invulnerability window
text.summy_enchantment.option.bow_inaccu: Bow spread factor; vanilla is 1, 0 means perfectly accurate

Keeps the trail visible beyond the entity sync range (64 blocks); the server sends the particles; player-shot arrows only
Radius of the long distance mode in blocks, default 128, max 512
Arrow particles on other mods' arrows
Also trail other mods' arrows (anything extending the arrow base); tridents and spears stay untouched, adjustable via datapack tags
text.summy_enchantment.option.melee_part: Particle for normal and critical melee hits; each player picks their own and others see it; player melee only; 0 keeps vanilla
text.summy_enchantment.option.melee_swee: Particle for sweeping hits, replacing the vanilla sweep arc; configured independently from crit; player melee only
text.summy_enchantment.option.surprise_p: Particle when Surprise triggers; intensity follows the melee particle intensity; player melee only
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_sur: Chance to make this attack count twice

text.summy_enchantment.option.phantom_ar: Extra arrow chance per level, 0.10 = +10% per level
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_end: No arrow is consumed and you can shoot without ammo; exclusive with Infinity
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_lif: Healing no longer heals; it repairs this piece instead, also at full health. Undamaged pieces keep normal healing
text.summy_enchantment.option.life_mendi: Durability converted per 1 healing per level, default 1
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_dea: Max health x1.5, healing received -50% (curse, can appear on the table)
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_sou: Revive on the spot at full health (treasure)
text.summy_enchantment.option.enable_stu: Caps durability loss per hit, based on that piece's max durability

text.summy_enchantment.option.nimble_ste: Sound played on a successful dodge, per player
